retrieval_skill.name: layered_event_impact_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve forecast-window events together with their timing, causal mechanism, and quantified impact, while separating physical demand drivers from observation-only changes and outages.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting an operational count that may be affected by scheduled events, system changes, or service interruptions during or near the forecast horizon.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search using the target metric and location or system class combined with forecast-window events, event timing, impact magnitude, outages, upgrades, and logging changes; extract claims into future-driver, observation, and availability layers.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Use only claims with explicit provenance and timing relevant to the forecast window; require a stated causal link before treating an event as a demand driver, preserve exact quoted magnitudes without extrapolation, and never convert logging-only changes into physical-count adjustments.
